therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: positive inotropy and heart rate reduction
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Heart failure patients requiring digoxin therapy
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Percent of patients achieving steady-state serum digoxin concentration between 0.5–0.9 ng/ml at 2–4 weeks

results.effect_size: 38.5% (nomogram) vs 34.8% (standard care) achieved target SDC 0.5–0.9 ng/ml
results.target_engagement_evidence: Mean serum digoxin concentration 0.52 ng/ml (nomogram) vs 1.12 ng/ml (standard); 86.2% vs 42.4% achieved SDC < 1.0 ng/ml
biomarker_changes: Mean SDC nomogram arm: 0.52 ng/ml; standard arm: 1.12 ng/ml
ABCB1 C1236T: Wild type 0.52, CT 0.56, TT 0.58 ng/ml (nomogram substudy, n=55)
ABCB1 C3435T: Wild type (CC) 0.54, CT 0.54, TT 0.46 ng/ml
ABCB1 G2677T/A: Wild type (GG) 0.54, GT 0.50, TT 0.66, GA 0.40 ng/ml
subgroup_findings: ABCB1 SNP genotype subgroups showed modest variation in SDC but no large pharmacogenetic effect in nomogram arm

context.duration: 2–4 weeks to steady state; trial ran December 2006 to December 2009
